statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let primes := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.Ioc x ((2*x)^2+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p^100000 ≤ (2*x)^132301); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000 ≤ n^132301); let angle := fun p k : ℕ => fun t : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * k * t / p; let phase := fun (p k n : ℕ) => Complex.exp (((angle p k n : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let coef := fun a x p k : ℕ => (∑ r ∈ roots a p, ∑ n ∈ window x p, Real.cos (angle p k ((n : ℝ) - r))) / p; let freqs := fun (p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (Finset.Ico 1 p).filter (fun k => if low then min k (p-k) ≤ Nat.sqrt p else Nat.sqrt p < min k (p-k)); let part := fun (a x p : ℕ) (low : Bool) => (∑ k ∈ freqs p low, coef a x p k) * Real.log (p : ℝ); let modes := fun (a x : ℕ) (low : Bool) => ∑ p ∈ primes x, part a x p low; ∀ x : ℕ, let u := fun p k : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ window x p, phase p k n; let v := fun p k : ℕ => ∑ r ∈ roots 1 p, phase p k r; modes 1 x false = ∑ p ∈ primes x, (∑ k ∈ freqs p false, (‖u p k+v p k‖^2-‖u p k-v p k‖^2)) / (4*(p : ℝ)) * Real.log (p : ℝ)
